title: Elon Musk questions Ambani’s influence as Starlink India launch stalls | TechCrunch
summary: SpaceX first attempted to launch Starlink in India in 2021. Jio and Airtel, India’s two biggest telcom operators, are also pursuing their own satellite internet services , even as they have agreed to distribute Starlink in India.
